findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?tools=user_info,web_unlocker,google_serp,yandex_serp,duckduckgo_serp,bing_serp,amazon,youtube,facebook,instagram,reddit,walmart,google,booking,indeed,airbnb,google_play_store,github,tiktok,linkedin,glassdoor,twitter,crunchbase,zillow,ebay,chatgpt" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: booking_hotellist, facebook_event, github_repository, indeed_companies_info, youtube_video_post · Private data: query_user_api_keys, query_user_info, youtube_audio, youtube_video · Public sink: facebook_comment, facebook_post, instagram_comment, reddit_comment, twitter_post, youtube_video_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: booking_hotellist, facebook_event, github_repository, indeed_companies_info, youtube_video_post · Private data: query_user_api_keys, query_user_info, youtube_audio, youtube_video · Public sink: facebook_comment, facebook_post, instagram_comment, reddit_comment, twitter_post, youtube_video_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
